sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.I.,C.S.C.,Rajesh Kumar Jaiswal
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
1.

The following prayer has been made in the present writ petition:
"Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus, directing Competent Authority/Special Land Acquisition Officer (Joint Organization) Bareilly Deepmala Sharma vs Union Of India And 6 Others on 26 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5491573/
1 (Respondent No. 5) to declare the award in regard to Village Mahawa, Tehsil Bisalpur, District Pilibhit pursuant to notification dated 16.03.2024 issued U/s 3-D of N a t i o n a l H i g h w a y A c t , 1 9 5 6 i n r e g a r d t o N a t i o n a l H i g h w a y - 7 3 1 K (Shahjahanpur-Bisalpur Khand) keeping in view the valuation submitted by Government of India (Ministry of Road Trasport and Highways) New Delhi dated 03.06.2024 already vetted by P.W.D. vide its report dated 15.06.2024 and to pay the compensation in regard to Gata No. 77 area 0.1700 hectare of Revenue Village Mahawa, Tehsil Bisalpur, District Pilibhit."
2. Indisputably the land of the petitioner was acquired under the provisions of the National Highways Act, 1956 in pursuance of notification under Section 3D dated 16.03.2024.

It appears that for purposes of quantification of compensation for the super structure, the acquiring body i.e.
Ministry of Road Trasport and Highways, New Delhi submitted a valuation report on basis of plinth area method.

entities.text: Ministry of Road Trasport and Highways, New Delhi
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: However, the case of the petitioner is that the Competent Authority sought some report from PWD with regard to the valuation of the super structure existing over the acquired land and in response to the same, PWD submitted a report on 15.06.2024 stating that the valuation arrived at by the acquiring body on basis of plinth area method is on higher side and it recommended for payment of a lower compensation based on item rate method.

3. Sri Anil Tiwari, learned Senior Counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that in respect of other lands covered by the same notification, the Competent Authority has awarded compensation by accepting the report of the acquiring body whereas in case of the petitioner, discrimination is being made.
4. Learned Standing Counsel has placed on record the instructions received from the Competent Authority.
It is admitted therein that so far no award has been declared in respect of the subject land.

The stand taken is that certain other reports have been sought and after the aspect relating to valuation of the super structure gets clarified, award would be declared.
5.

Since the award has not been declared, we are of the opinion that interest of justice would be served in permitting the petitioner to represent to the Competent Authority along with true attested copy of the instant order in respect of mode of valuation of the super structure so that the same is duly taken into account while declaring the award.

6. Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of with the said liberty to the petitioner and with direction to the Competent Authority to consider the issue raised by the petitioner while declaring the award.

Order Date :- 26.5.2025 Ashish Pd.
(Anish Kumar Gupta,J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.)
